description: Representative Kirk Haskins joined lawmakers, candidates, and community members at the Chucks and Pearls rally at the Kansas Statehouse on September 19. Haskins delivered remarks during the Topeka event, which brought participants together at the Capitol ahead of the November election. His appearance at the rally was featured in national media coverage distributed by Reuters Connect.Source: Reuters ConnectRead the full story:https://www.reutersconnect.com/item/rep-kirk-haskins-d-topeka-gives-rem
